name: vies-vat-validator-mcp
title: VIES VAT Validator MCP
description: Validate EU VAT numbers via the official free VIES SOAP API, with a free local format-precheck cache and bilingual (中/EN) error codes. Built for cross-border e-commerce and trade compliance. 用欧盟官方免费 VIES 接口校验 VAT 税号，含本地格式缓存与中英双语错误码，面向跨境电商/外贸合规。
